source_refs.note: Exercise 6.1, Question 3: circle through three points, centre and radius (Case-1); book p. 173, answers p. 304 (PDF 306)

blocks.prompt: 3 Find an equation of circle passing through the points \((2, 8)\), \((5, -1)\) and \((-3, 3)\), also find the centre and radius.
blocks.explanation:
Teen aise points diye hain jo ek seedhi line mein nahi (non-collinear), aur aise teen points se sirf ek hi circle guzarta hai.
Diya kya hai? Points \((2, 8)\), \((5, -1)\), \((-3, 3)\).
Find kya karna hai? Circle ki equation, centre aur radius.
Rule kaunsa? 6.1.5 ka Case-1 (Example 5 wala tareeqa): general form mein teen unknowns \(g, f, c\) hain.
Plan: har point rakh kar ek equation, teen equations se \(g, f, c\), phir centre \((-g, -f)\) aur radius \(\sqrt{g^2 + f^2 - c}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: circle \((2, 8)\), \((5, -1)\), \((-3, 3)\) se guzarta hai.
Maloom karna: equation, centre, radius.
Tareeqa: Case-1. General form mein teen unknowns hain aur humare paas teen points, yani teen conditions. Teen equations, teen unknowns: bilkul pura hisaab.

Circle farz karein
\[x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 \quad (A)\]
Kyun: Har circle ki equation is general form mein likhi ja sakti hai; bas \(g, f, c\) maloom karne hain.

\((2, 8)\) rakhein
\[4 + 64 + 4g + 16f + c = 0\]
\[4g + 16f + c + 68 = 0 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Jo point circle par ho, woh us ki equation ko satisfy karta hai. \(x = 2\), \(y = 8\) rakha: \(2g(2) = 4g\), \(2f(8) = 16f\).

\((5, -1)\) rakhein
\[25 + 1 + 10g - 2f + c = 0\]
\[10g - 2f + c + 26 = 0 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(y = -1\) se \((-1)^2 = 1\) aur \(2f(-1) = -2f\).
Dhyan dein: Negative ka square positive hota hai, lekin \(2f y\) wala term negative rehta hai.

\(c\) khatam karein
\[(1) - (2):\ -6g + 18f + 42 = 0\]
\[g - 3f - 7 = 0 \quad (4)\]
\[(2) - (3):\ 16g - 8f + 8 = 0\]
\[2g - f + 1 = 0 \quad (5)\]
Kyun: Teeno equations mein \(c\) ka coefficient 1 hai, to minus karne se \(c\) ud jata hai aur do variables ki do equations bachti hain. (4) ko \(-6\) se aur (5) ko 8 se divide kar ke chhota kiya.

(4) aur (5) hal karein
\[g = 3f + 7\]
\[2(3f + 7) - f + 1 = 0\]
\[5f + 15 = 0,\quad f = -3\]
\[g = 3(-3) + 7 = -2\]
Kyun: (4) se \(g\) ki value \(f\) mein nikal kar (5) mein rakhi (substitution). Is se ek hi variable ki equation bani.

(1) se \(c\) nikalein
\[4(-2) + 16(-3) + c + 68 = 0\]
\[-56 + c + 68 = 0,\quad c = -12\]
Kyun: \(g\) aur \(f\) mil gaye to kisi bhi pehli equation mein rakh kar \(c\) mil jata hai.

Equation, centre aur radius
\[x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 6y - 12 = 0\]
\[\text{centre} = (-g, -f) = (2, 3)\]
\[r = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 12} = 5\]
Kyun: (A) mein \(2g = -4\), \(2f = -6\), \(c = -12\) rakha. Radius formula \(\sqrt{g^2 + f^2 - c}\) mein \(-c = +12\) ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Centre \((g, f)\) nahi, \((-g, -f)\) hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[(5, -1):\ 25 + 1 - 20 + 6 - 12 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[(-3, 3):\ 9 + 9 + 12 - 18 - 12 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har diya hua point aakhri equation ko satisfy karta hai; \((2, 8)\) ke liye bhi \(4 + 64 - 8 - 48 - 12 = 0\). Teeno points centre \((2, 3)\) se 5 units door hain.
